_comment: Test-depth ratchet baseline (decision H-D5). RECORDED FROM CI, which is the environment that enforces it: CI collects fewer tests than a developer box (300 cart there vs 415 locally) because optional and GPU-gated dependencies are absent, so a locally-captured baseline fails instantly. A local run measures at or above these numbers and passes, which is the right asymmetry. Regenerate deliberately; a drop below these is a regression, not a new normal.
